_comment: Mutation testing, pointed at one file on purpose. src/lib/scan.ts is arithmetic on thresholds and a chain of conditions, the kind of code a test can cover line by line while asserting nothing that would notice an 80 turning into a 79. Stryker changes each number and each comparison in turn and the tests have to fail. A React hook or a route would drown this in mutants nothing can kill, so they are not here. Run it with `just mutate`.
